import re

def extract_demo(text,n=2):

 print(bool(m))
 if not m: return
 g1=[list(map(int,l.split())) for l in m.group(3).strip().splitlines()]
 g2=[list(map(int,l.split())) for l in m.group(4).strip().splitlines()]
 return g1,g2
